staff_closure.loading.description: In place of the closure's screens while the closure is read. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.failed.defaultMessage: The closure could not be loaded.
staff_closure.failed.description: In place of the closure's screens when the closure could not be read, before Try again. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.announcement.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the heading of the section of the announcement of the closure. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.none.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), while no closure is announced. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.announce.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the button to the form that announces the closure, and that form's title. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.announce.press.description: On the form of the closure's announcement (/admin/closure/announcement), the button that sends the announcement, and the confirmation of its question. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.change.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the button to the form that changes the dates of the announcement, and that form's title. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.withdraw.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the button that withdraws the announcement (asked first), and the confirmation of its question. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.withdraw.title.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the question before withdrawing the announcement. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.withdraw.text.defaultMessage: The server runs on as before, and every user gets a notification and an email. Refused sign-ups and ended supporter subscriptions stay as they are.
staff_closure.withdraw.text.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), what follows withdrawing the announcement. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.short_notice.defaultMessage: Less than 30 days' notice: some users may not have the time to export their data and move.
staff_closure.short_notice.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), under the announcement's facts when it gives less than 30 days' notice. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.close.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the heading of the section that leads to closing the server, and the title of the check before it. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.check.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the button to the check before closing the server, once the closing date has passed. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.close.wait.defaultMessage: You can close the server once {date} has passed.
staff_closure.close.wait.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), in place of the way to close the server before the closing date ({date}, a date and time). Read by administrators.

staff_closure.close.press.description: On the check before closing the server (/admin/closure/close), the button that asks before closing the server, and the confirmation of its question. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.close.refused.defaultMessage: The server cannot be closed now. Go back to the closure and check its state.
staff_closure.close.refused.description: On the check before closing the server (/admin/closure/close), when the server refused the closure in the state it is in. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.close.not_yet.defaultMessage: {why, select, none {Announce the closure first.} early {You can close the server once {date} has passed.} other {The server is closed.}}
staff_closure.close.not_yet.description: On the check before closing the server (/admin/closure/close), in place of Close the server while it cannot be closed ({date}, the closing date and time). Read by administrators.

staff_closure.close.title.description: On the check before closing the server (/admin/closure/close), the question before closing the server ({domain}, the server's domain, typed to confirm). Read by administrators.

staff_closure.close.text.defaultMessage: Users can only sign in and export their data until {date}. About {deletes, number} deliveries ask the other servers to delete this server's accounts. This cannot be undone.
staff_closure.close.text.description: On the check before closing the server (/admin/closure/close), what follows closing the server ({date}, the export deadline; {deletes}, a number). Read by administrators.

staff_closure.close.heading.description: On the check before closing the server (/admin/closure/close), the heading of the last section, which holds the mark of what cannot be undone and the button that closes the server. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.closed.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the heading of the section of a closed server. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.progress.defaultMessage: Deleting the accounts, here and on other servers
staff_closure.progress.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the heading of the progress of the delivery of the deletion of every local account. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.progress.accounts.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the label of the number of local accounts whose deletion was recorded. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.progress.fanouts.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the label of the number of deletions whose receiving servers are still being found. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.progress.pending.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the label of the number of deliveries not attempted yet or to be attempted again. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.progress.refused.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the label of the number of deliveries refused for good. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.progress.skipped.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the label of the number of deliveries not sent, to a suspended or unavailable server. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.progress.dead.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the label of the number of deliveries that used up their attempts. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.progress.going.defaultMessage: Deliveries go on. Keep the server and its workers running until they end.
staff_closure.progress.going.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), under the progress while deliveries go on. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.progress.done.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), under the progress once every delivery has ended. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.progress.meter.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the name of the meter of the deliveries of the deletion of the accounts that have ended, delivered or not, of all of them (staff_closure.progress.ended under it says the numbers). Read by administrators.

staff_closure.progress.undelivered.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the heading over the deliveries that failed: refused, skipped, out of attempts. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.progress.ended.defaultMessage: {ended, number} of {all, number} ended: {succeeded, number} delivered, {failed, number} not delivered
staff_closure.progress.ended.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), under the meter of the deliveries of the deletion of the accounts: those ended of all, and of them those delivered and those not delivered (numbers). Read by administrators.

staff_closure.state.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the state of an announced closure beside its mark: announced, or its closing date passed and the server not closed yet. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.fact.state.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the term of where the closure stands. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.fact.closes.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the term of the closing date and time. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.fact.closed.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the term of when the server was closed. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.fact.export_until.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the term of the last moment the users can export their data. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.fact.announced.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the term of when the announcement or its last change of dates was made. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.fact.message.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the term of the operator's message to the users. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.irreversible.defaultMessage: Closing ends the service. This cannot be undone.
staff_closure.irreversible.description: On the check before closing the server (/admin/closure/close), the mark beside Close the server. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.form.dates.description: On the form of the closure's announcement (/admin/closure/announcement), the heading of the section of the closing date and the export deadline. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.form.closes.description: On the form of the closure's announcement (/admin/closure/announcement), the name of the closing date and time's field. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.form.closes.missing.defaultMessage: Choose the closing date and time.
staff_closure.form.closes.missing.description: On the form of the closure's announcement (/admin/closure/announcement), under the closing date when it is empty or no whole date and time. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.form.until.description: On the form of the closure's announcement (/admin/closure/announcement), the name of the field of the last moment the users can export their data. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.form.until.about.defaultMessage: Left empty, the export deadline is 30 days after the closing date.
staff_closure.form.until.about.description: On the form of the closure's announcement (/admin/closure/announcement), the line under the heading of the dates: the export deadline's default. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.form.until.before.defaultMessage: Choose a moment on or after the closing date.
staff_closure.form.until.before.description: On the form of the closure's announcement (/admin/closure/announcement), under the export deadline when it is before the closing date. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.form.message.description: On the form of the closure's announcement (/admin/closure/announcement), the heading of the section of the operator's message, shown in the notices and on the closed server's page. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.form.closed.defaultMessage: The server is closed, so no closure can be announced.
staff_closure.form.closed.description: On the form of the closure's announcement (/admin/closure/announcement), when the server is closed already. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.form.short.description: On the form of the closure's announcement (/admin/closure/announcement), beside the button when the closing date is less than 30 days away. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.form.refused.defaultMessage: {field, select, closes_at {Choose another closing date.} export_until {Choose a moment on or after the closing date.} other {Shorten the message to 5,000 characters.}}
staff_closure.form.refused.description: On the form of the closure's announcement (/admin/closure/announcement), under the field the server refused. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.ask.announce.title.description: On the form of the closure's announcement (/admin/closure/announcement), the question before announcing the closure. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.ask.announce.text.defaultMessage: Every user gets a notification and an email. Sign-ups and invites stop, waiting sign-ups are refused, and supporter subscriptions end at the end of their period. Withdrawing the closure does not undo these.
staff_closure.ask.announce.text.description: On the form of the closure's announcement (/admin/closure/announcement), what follows announcing the closure. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.ask.change.title.description: On the form of the closure's announcement (/admin/closure/announcement), the question before changing the dates of the announcement. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.ask.change.text.defaultMessage: Every user gets a notification and an email with the new dates.
staff_closure.ask.change.text.description: On the form of the closure's announcement (/admin/closure/announcement), what follows changing the dates of the announcement. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.check.heading.description: On the check before closing the server (/admin/closure/close), the heading of what closing would end. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.check.deletes.description: On the check before closing the server (/admin/closure/close), the term of the estimate of the deliveries of the deletion of every local account. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.check.migrations.description: On the check before closing the server (/admin/closure/close), the term of the account migrations not ended. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.check.holds.description: On the check before closing the server (/admin/closure/close), the term of the accounts whose records are held. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.check.count.description: On the check before closing the server (/admin/closure/close), a count of the check, as a number. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.check.migrations.warning.defaultMessage: Wait for the moves to end: nobody can start one after the closure.
staff_closure.check.migrations.warning.description: On the check before closing the server (/admin/closure/close), while account moves have not ended. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.check.holds.warning.defaultMessage: Export the records under a hold with the command line, and keep them outside the server.
staff_closure.check.holds.warning.description: On the check before closing the server (/admin/closure/close), while accounts are under a retention hold. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.check.deletes.value.defaultMessage: About {deletes, number} ({accounts, number} accounts to {inboxes, number} servers)
staff_closure.check.deletes.value.description: On the check before closing the server (/admin/closure/close), the estimate of the deliveries ({deletes}), the local accounts ({accounts}) and the known inboxes ({inboxes}), numbers. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.check.subscriptions.defaultMessage: Supporter subscriptions ended at once, without a refund
staff_closure.check.subscriptions.description: On the check before closing the server (/admin/closure/close), the term of the supporter subscriptions that the closure cancels. Read by administrators.
